method: Solid full cube models verified from pinned jars; RGB is arithmetic sRGB mean over frame-zero effectively opaque pixels (alpha >=254), area weighted over six cube faces. No textures or assets redistributed. Stair/slab IDs proven present and matching exact base texture set or direct shaped crafting recipe. State rules extracted from visual blockstate variants, supplemented by standard StairBlock/SlabBlock waterlogged Boolean (omitted in visual variants because it does not change models).

mods.label: Create

embedded_dependencies.reason: Versions before 0.6.9 do not include the neccesary APIs Create needs to work properly with Sodium.
Versions before 0.14.7 crash when paired with Create, Update Lithium.
Versions before 1.21.1-6.0.0-beta.46 do not contain the APIs Create requires to work with JourneyMap.
Versions before 1.40.2 do not contain the classes Create requires to work with Xaero's World Map.
Radium is a unofficial port of Lithium, Lithium is now natively available for NeoForge and does not suffer from the same issues radium does, use Lithium instead.
Palladium does not improve memory usage by anything meaningful, and results in broken visuals for Create's blocks with connected textures.
